calibration.rule: Overlap years whose region-wide S-NPP/Aqua ratio is within ±15% of the median year ratio (6.36); outage months excluded.

choice_reason: M3 (Ratio per country and month (shrinkage)) is the simplest model whose cross-validated MAE (76.4) is within 5% of the best (M3: 76.4). (chosen on development years only)

validation.split_rule: The last four calibration years are held out as final test years; all model and lambda choices use only the earlier development years.
validation.choice_reason_dev: M3 (Ratio per country and month (shrinkage)) is the simplest model whose cross-validated MAE (76.4) is within 5% of the best (M3: 76.4).

decision.rule: Adopt the local factor only if, on the held-out test years, it lowers the small-region MAE and does not lower the hit rate for high-activity months by more than 5 points.
decision.text: The local factor was adopted: it lowered the small-region error on the test years.

validation.high_rule: A month is high-activity when it is 'Higher' or 'Much higher' than usual (percentile rank >= 75 vs the same month in the other calibration years, with the small-count guard).

uncertainty.how: Median absolute % error on the held-out test years (countries; small regions separately), for months with at least 10 actual VIIRS hotspots.

terra_aqua_alternative.note: Same model using Terra+Aqua MODIS instead of Aqua only.

noaa20_to_snpp.why: M1 (One global ratio) is the simplest model whose cross-validated MAE (39.2) is within 5% of the best (M1: 39.2).

frp_test.hypothesis: Summed FRP is more stable between sensors than counts.
frp_test.rule: FRP is offered as a calendar metric only if the VIIRS/MODIS FRP ratio varies less (lower coefficient of variation) than the count ratio, pooled and in most countries.

colour_agreement.busy_rule: months whose usual (median of other years) is at least 30 hotspots
